issues.description: Field: Farm.animals. Problem statement/UML and task text require an encapsulated animals collection with access via getter and setter (the UML shows "- animals: List<Animal>" and the task text asks for a getter and setter and to initialize the list in the Farm constructor). The solution implementation declares the field as public: 'public List<Animal> animals;' in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java, which contradicts the intended private visibility and the encapsulation requirement. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected visibility and correct implementation pattern (private field + public getter/setter).
issues.suggestedFix: Change the field declaration in the solution to a private attribute to match the UML and task instructions: declare 'private List<Animal> animals;'. Keep the existing public getAnimals() and setAnimals(...) methods. Update any internal accesses in the solution to use the field directly (inside the class) and ensure external access uses the getter/setter. If the template/example also exposes the field publicly, update it similarly to preserve consistency with the problem statement.
